constraints.note: f19/f28 (t0000_38-t0000_75): jaws close at the cap end, above CoM; pendulum swing after lift confirms above-CoM grasp enabling gravity self-reorientation (core per pinned physics fact).

missing.name: center_align
missing.note: t0002_75: tube is centered directly over the target hole before descent; lateral center alignment is load-bearing for entering the hole and was extracted in stages 3/5 but not here.

constraints.note: f121-f129 (t0004_50-t0004_83): jaws grip at the cap end, above CoM; tube pendulums freely after lift, confirming the load-bearing grasp region.

all cited frames f129/f137/f145 (t0004_83-t0005_47) show the tube 30-45 deg off vertical mid-swing, and it is still tilted at stage end t0005_80; vertical only in stage 3 (t0006_90). Mis-staged claim.

f112-f129 (t0004_50): low lateral approach from the right supports 'side', but the elevation/azimuth choice on a symmetric lying tube is an equivalence-class sample (stage 0 used top_down on an identical tube); per rubric symmetry principle.

t0005_80 (f129-f137): grasp still at the cap end/upper region at stage end.

f200: tube1 centered in the hole (implied by fully seated pose).

missing.name: carry
missing.note: Stage includes the whole transport t0005_80->t0006_90 plus insertion; the hold must persist until release after seating. Stage 1 extracted the analogous carry(gripper_holds_tube0); absent here.

missing.name: carry
